title: Correct quarantined and fixed event classification

root_cause.boundary: frontend/src/adapters/wire.ts::projectAnchored (read-model projection) + every consumer that trusted capacityClass
root_cause.mechanism: projectAnchored recognized only 'work' and 'ignored' as explicit calendar classes, so any calendar row carrying capacity_class 'quarantined' (known-but-unreviewed title, frozen contract 17) fell through to capacityClass 'fixed'. The row then displayed as Fixed in CalendarImpact, walled the client-side overflow scan (calendarWalls skips only ignored), entered the fixed-input fingerprint (projectFixedInputs counted it attending), and appeared under 'Fixed commitments' in the manual export prompt — all contradicting the server, which excludes quarantined rows from planning capacity, walls, and the judgment payload (main.py::_judged_anchored, _capacity_frame, sequence.py::_CALENDAR_EXCLUDED_CLASSES)

frontend_production: frontend/src/model/types.ts: CalendarCapacityClass gains 'quarantined' (fourth explicit wire class)
frontend/src/adapters/wire.ts::projectAnchored: 'quarantined' passes through verbatim instead of collapsing to fixed

frontend/src/adapters/wire.ts::projectFixedInputs: quarantined rows excluded from fixed-input calendar commitments — they never affect planning, so their presence/absence must not invalidate a staged plan
frontend/src/fixtures/scenarios.ts::fixedInputsOf: mirrors the wire normalization (comment promises parity)
frontend/src/model/overflow.ts::calendarWalls: quarantined rows wall nothing, alongside ignored (contract 17) — no hidden hard wall client-side
frontend/src/ui/CalendarImpact.tsx: quarantined rows render class badge 'quarantined', reason 'Not counted', counted blocks 0 — never Fixed
frontend/src/store/exportPrompt.ts: quarantined rows excluded from the 'Fixed commitments — do not move these' section of the manual LLM fallback
fix.backend_production: none — fetch_calendar_busy (work/fixed/ignored/quarantined), main.py::_judged_anchored and _capacity_frame (both drop quarantined), and sequence.py (excluded classes) already encode the contract; FEEDBACK-02/03 tests cover them. New tests pin the pipeline with fixture titles

regression_tests.behavior: Cooking (fixed) and Trivia Night (work) pass through; Steelers Game (quarantined) projects as capacityClass 'quarantined' — never Fixed; projectFixedInputs.calendar contains exactly Cooking and Trivia Night, never the quarantined row
regression_tests.red_before_fix: both failed — Steelers Game projected as capacityClass 'fixed' and entered the fixed-input list

regression_tests.behavior: a quarantined Steelers 20:00-22:00 row walls nothing; the fixed Cooking 20:30-21:00 row beside it still walls its interval
regression_tests.red_before_fix: failed — quarantined row (projected as fixed) emitted a 20:00-22:00 wall

regression_tests.test: CalendarImpact labels quarantined rows excluded (1 test)
regression_tests.behavior: Steelers Game renders badge 'quarantined', reason 'Not counted', '0 blk counted'; configured fixed Cooking beside it still renders Fixed with '1 blk counted' (accounted exactly once)
regression_tests.red_before_fix: failed — quarantined row rendered as Fixed with 2 blk counted

regression_tests.test: excludes quarantined calendar rows from Fixed commitments (1 test)
regression_tests.behavior: a quarantined Steelers row added to the ready scenario does not appear in the prompt's '## Fixed commitments' section
regression_tests.red_before_fix: failed — 'Steelers Game: 8 PM · 120min (calendar event)' appeared under Fixed commitments

regression_tests.behavior: fetch_calendar_busy classifies Cooking->fixed, Trivia Night->work, Steelers Game->quarantined per EXPLICIT config rules (unconfigured known title stays quarantined, never label-guessed); _capacity_frame then counts Cooking exactly once (fixed=1), Trivia inside the work envelope (work_busy=2, overflow=0), and the quarantined Steelers 20:00-22:00 overlap costs zero and does not inflate work_busy or mint
regression_tests.red_before_fix: n/a — backend already encoded the contract; tests pass immediately as contract pins (frontend projection was the defect)

test_results.frontend_focused: wire.test.ts + overflow.test.ts + calendar-capacity.test.tsx + exportPrompt.test.ts: 77 passed (72 baseline + 5 new)
test_results.bundle_readback: built app/static/cockpit and mockups/cockpit bundles both contain the quarantined class token (read back, not assumed)

ignored rows remain in the fixed-input fingerprint (pre-existing) — only quarantined was in this defect; ignored rows already wall nothing and count zero everywhere else
